info.title: Morpheus
info.description:
Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code) — register an OAuth client on your Morpheus appliance with a client secret and redirect URI, complete the authorization_code flow against /oauth/authorize and /oauth/token, and provide the resulting access/refresh tokens. See the README for full setup steps.

Morpheus is a cloud management platform that provides provisioning, monitoring, logging, backups, and application deployment strategies across public, private, and hybrid clouds.

Source: https://github.com/HewlettPackard/morpheus-openapi
